topic: AI tool tutorial: AI agents can now pay for things. 5 rules before you let one shop for you
post:
AI agents can now buy things for you. 🛒
Before you let one shop on your behalf, set these 5 rules.

What's new:
OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its "dots" agents complete purchases for you. It's rolling out first to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers (18+) with eligible US cards.

How it works, per OpenAI and coverage from Decrypt and Digital Trends:
💳 You add a card once
🙈 The agent never sees your actual card number
✅ At launch, you review and approve every purchase

Your 5 rules for any AI shopping agent 👇
1️⃣ Start with one small, low-risk purchase
2️⃣ Tell it your limits: max price, brands, delivery date
3️⃣ Read the approval screen like a receipt, every time
4️⃣ Check your card statement for the first few weeks
5️⃣ Keep big or unusual purchases manual 🔒

Good to know:
Stores and card issuers can still block or reject agent purchases, so expect some to fail.

Why it matters:
AI is moving from suggesting things to doing things. That's handy, and it means your approval is now the most important click. ⚖️

Practical takeaway:
Write your shopping limits down once, and paste them into every agent request.

Would you let an AI agent buy things for you? 👇
